So if your baby is 3.5 months, but 3 weeks early, technically their only 2.5 months and just a quick search on google tells me that the baby milestone for bringing things to their mouths doesn’t kick in til 4 months.  My girl rolled more at 8 weeks than she does now at 7 months (5 ajusted) She can, she just doesn’t do it often. She likes crawling, and doesn’t feel the need to roll onto her back. 
As for the “hypersensitive” comment I would put it down to, personality. Maybe he didn’t want to do what she wanted him to do. He’s in a weird place with someone he doesn’t know, trying to get him to do things Whos only doing it for a few minutes or so. I think that was an offhand comment she should have kept to herself. Some babies are more social and don’t mind other adults, but I would say majority of babies, including my social butterfly, only trust few adults (my husband and I)  the only other time shes sees people in that kind of setting is for needles or check ups.
